title: Unique restriction of a local cocone across prime localization
statement: Let R, p, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K, χ : κ_R(p) → K, q and ψ : κ_A(q) → K [def-weil-residue-field] satisfy the parent hypotheses: the evaluation through ψ is the specified A-algebra map into K, and its restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Use pointed étale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and the compatible-leg relation [new-def-sbc-etale-triples-prime-localization-cocone-relation]. For every ring V and every local cocone θ, there exists a unique global cocone η satisfying this relation.

proof.text: Base change each global etale algebra B to R_p, equivalently localize B at the images of R outside p. Denominators are nonzero in K, so its pointing extends uniquely. Take the prime kernel and factor through its residue field; the compatible base map gives inverse image q.

Restrict the local cocone leg to B. Global-triple morphisms extend uniquely to these localized triples, giving naturality. Each pointed R-map from B into a local triple extends uniquely to the base-change algebra as a pointed A-map, so local-cocone naturality proves the compatible-leg relation. The canonical map from B to its localized triple forces the restriction leg, proving uniqueness.
